Disappointment at Thai Street
Mar 2019 • Friends
First of all I am not an expert on Thai food so maybe the delicious Thai food I have encountered else where may not be as authentic as that in Thai Street and hence maybe I am not used to the real Thai taste. But despite having high hopes and very good recommendations and enjoying the atmospheric decor, we did not really find a dish that we really enjoyed. We shared a dish of minced chicken with chilis as we could not find a spicy dish we fancied with chicken pieces, but although nice and spicy, we did not enjoy the mince texture. Also when ordering the green vegetable curry we checked that it could be made without fish sauce which we were assured it would be but when it came it has an overriding taste of fish sauce, We also found the pork satay to be too fatty and unpalatable. The coconut rolled ice cream looked delicious but again we found it lack lustre and not very delicious. I would guess that maybe we don't like Thai food too much other than we quite often go to one or two in D1 which we really enjoy, admittedly different dishes than advertised in Thai Street. Shame as it really was an appealing looking place with very pleasant staff.

Thailand recreated
Apr 2019 • Friends
Thai Street - the move to the Snap Cafe complex hasn’t taken away from the charm of the place. The decor reflects the streets of Bangkok. And the Pa- Khao menu allowing you to order a little bit of a variety of street food reminds me of the Indian thali. The mince chicken and pork with basil were my favourites followed by the Thai omelette. The veg as well as the non veg green curry need improving and the veg papaya salad disappointing.A good option for the vegetarians who have a menu to themselves. An Ac room exists but it was pleasant enough outside. Service and feel were good and prices reasonable.
